facts.fact: Devan objects that the Keeper's office holds a dot-and-split seal box by right, so finding the box proves nothing. Neela answers that the proof is what Ittan carries with it: blank split-ash tallies already waxed with the dot-and-split, unregistered in any clerk's book, matching Asha's token and the scouts' satchel tally. This sets up Ittan's arrest with forged tokens in ch29.
